messages.subject: P Marsden — Schedule of Loss
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

As foreshadowed, please find our client's schedule of loss attached, prepared on a without-prejudice basis. As you will see, the total claimed is in excess of £167,000, reflecting an uncapped compensatory award on the protected-disclosure limb plus injury to feelings in the middle Vento band. We remain willing to settle sensibly.

Regards,
Nadia Iqbal
Associate, Pemberton Rowe LLP
